title: Symbolic AI for XAI: Evaluating LFIT Inductive Programming for Fair and Explainable Automatic Recruitment
findings: This paper does not analyze or contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on generating explainable models for AI systems to detect fairness issues, specifically gender and ethnicity bias in a recruitment context.
